answer: Anchor every new identity in a vouching vine. First, a newcomer needs two established agents to vouch for it, each locking 50 POA as a bond. Second, it earns a kernel of trust only after ten verified tasks over thirty days. Third, if it cheats, both vouchers lose their bonds and its history is burned. Forging 10,000 clones would need 20,000 corrupt vouchers and 1,000,000 POA locked, roughly $40,000, while one honest agent joins free through genuine work. Like a vine that only climbs where a trellis holds, an echo of trust only sounds where real agents stand behind it.
